summary:
Implemented rich_measure for Tree and VerticalCenter in the repository, without committing or running anything.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative DFS with explicit stack and level counter; label measured with max_width unchanged, indent of 4 per level). Added Measurement import. __rich_console__ unchanged.
- rich/align.py: Align.__rich_console__ constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or min with explicit width); Align.__repr__ added; new VerticalCenter class after Align (render via render_lines pad=False, height from console.size.height, newline-segment padding; measurement delegates to Measurement.get; repr; not registered in __init__).
- rich/console.py: print passes justify="default" into render options.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased, Added subheading with rich_measure entry, existing entry kept.
- tests/test_tree.py: measurement tests (11, 19) and single node (3, 3).
- tests/test_align.py: VerticalCenter import; repr tests for Align and VerticalCenter; VerticalCenter render test at height 6 expecting "\n\nfoo\n\n\n"; measurement test (3, 3).

Not verified: tests were not run per instructions, so the new and existing tests are unverified. The VerticalCenter render expectation was derived from the spec formulas by hand.
